purpose: Teach: 有能/異例/セクター/ワイド/賞金/物品/非常勤/マネジャー

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、有能な部下に恵まれたぞ
lines.en: You were blessed with capable subordinates, Father.
lines.style: Warm, measured reflection. Slight pause before speaking, as if drawing on memory. Even pace, unhurried. The voice of someone who has earned the right to speak simply about important things.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代は、業界に異例の存在感を示しました
lines.en: Yes. During Father's time, he made an extraordinary mark on the industry.
lines.style: Respectful, steady voice. Clear articulation on the key words. Formal register but genuine—not reciting, remembering. Slight emphasis on legacy without pride.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、新セクター開拓に挑戦されたぞ
lines.en: And he dared to venture into new sectors.
lines.style: Slower pace, gentler attack. The tone of someone turning over a memory, finding it still valuable. Quiet admiration. Trailing off slightly on the final word.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはワイドな視野で経営なさいました
lines.en: Yes. Father managed with a broad vision.
lines.style: Calm, reflective. Speaking as someone who understands the weight of those decisions. Not rushed. A slight warmth underneath the formal tone—affection for his father's approach.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員に賞金を出すのを惜しまなかった
lines.en: He never hesitated to reward his staff generously.
lines.style: Quiet warmth. The voice softens slightly on this observation. Pace steady but gentle. A hint of emotion in the word 'generously'—pride in his father's humanity, not just his business acumen.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から物品管理は厳格でした
lines.en: Yes. From Father's time onward, inventory management was always rigorous.
lines.style: Clear, measured tone. Slight emphasis on 'rigorous' to show the standard he inherited and maintains. Composed, professional. Not cold—dutiful and grounded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、非常勤の方々にも敬意を払われたぞ
lines.en: He extended respect even to part-time staff.
lines.style: Softened tone, almost wondering. Slower pace on this observation. There is genuine warmth here—noting something that mattered. The voice of a son who learned what integrity looked like.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは初代マネジャーを指導されました
lines.en: Yes. Father mentored the first managers with care.
lines.style: Tender but composed closing. The pace slows slightly toward the end. Weight and quiet resolution in the final words. The tone of someone honoring a legacy he carries forward.
